title: Subcanonical pro-etale topology
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let X_proetale be its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The pro-etale topology on X_proetale is subcanonical: for every object V of X_proetale, the presheaf h_V=Hom_X(-,V) is a sheaf of sets.

mathlib_match.how: exact: lines 175-176 assert (topology S).Subcanonical for every scheme S, with no extra hypothesis. The site is Scheme.ProEt S (lines 99-102), schemes weakly etale over S with S-morphisms, and ProEt.topology S (lines 150-157) is generated by the same pro-etale covering families as def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site. Subcanonical means precisely that every representable is a sheaf: CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Subcanonical.isSheaf_of_isRepresentable, Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Canonical.lean:151-153, applied to yoneda.obj V. No additional mathematical lemma or coefficient convention is needed. Read 2026-10-14.
